structured_output.text:
Batch: 8 runs, all 8 accepted. None flagged; all 8 cleared (r01 to r08).
Checks: every rigid-invariance and closure check passed. Plane sections passed on r01 to r04, r07 and r08. It was not run on r05 and r06, which report the width-free ratio (one remedy kept, no roll backs).
r05: its centre REGR peak is about 2.1x that of r04 (111.9 vs 53.2 %/h). Its peak position (421 µm) and growth-zone length (695 µm) match the batch, and its stride is 1, so the frame pairing does not rescale the rate. This reads as a faster root, not a rescaled strain rate.
r01 and r07: they have large |z| only because the batch MAD is near zero. The growth zone is 21 µm (about 3%) shorter, and the flank difference of -0.81 %/h is a small sign flip next to a 53 %/h centre peak, with plane sections passing. The velocity and strain-rate profiles keep the batch shape.
Note: several runs have identical checks and summaries (r02, r03, r06 and r08; r01 and r07; r04 and r05 checks). This may be worth checking upstream as possible duplicate inputs.
